headline: You're invited to Seven Friends
note: It does not work inside Messenger or other apps.
homeStepShare: Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen
homeStepOpenPaste: Open Seven Friends from its icon, tap “{{ label }}”, paste the invitation and create your account
homeStepOpen: Open Seven Friends from its icon and create your account there
homeNote: Safari and the app on your home screen do not share logins, so the account is made in the app.
sorry: Sorry for the extra steps! On iPhone, Seven Friends works best on your home screen, so your account and lock key stay safe in one place.
thenHome: After that, Safari shows you how to add Seven Friends to your home screen, where you create your account.
menuStep: Tap ⋯ (or the compass icon), then Open in Safari
menuFallback: Can't find it? Copy the link, open Safari and paste it there.
safariRisk: In Safari, your account and lock key can be wiped if you do not open it for a week. Add the app to your home screen as soon as you can, and approve it from Safari.
